reason: Airtable returns linked-record fields as bare rec... IDs. --expand-links resolves them to the linked record's display value from the local mirror filled by `records sync-table`. The flag and one post-read call are hand-added to the two generated endpoint files, because the generator has no hook for post-read response transforms on endpoint commands.
validated_outcome: TestRecordsExpandLinksAcceptance: without the flag, Company stays ["rec2"]; with it, the value becomes ["Acme"].
